==English==

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|fro|esploit|pos=n}}, {{m|fro|esploitier|pos=v}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{qualifier|noun}} {{enPR|ĕks'ploit}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈɛksplɔɪt/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-exploit (noun).wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{qualifier|verb}} {{enPR|ĭksploit'}}, {{IPA|en|/ɪksˈplɔɪt/}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-exploit.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɔɪt|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[heroic]] or extraordinary [[deed]].
#* {{RQ:Kyd Spanish Tragedie|page=19|passage=''Hieronimo'', it greatly pleaſeth vs, / That in our victorie thou haue a ſhare, / By vertue of thy vvorthy Sonnes '''exployt'''.}}
# An [[achievement]].
#: {{ux|en|The first trek to the summit of Mount Everest was a stunning '''exploit'''.}}
# {{lb|en|computing}} A [[program]] or technique that [[take advantage|takes advantage]] of a [[vulnerability]] in other [[software]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2004|author=Rob Shein|title=Zero-Day Exploit: Countdown to Darkness|url=https://books.google.de/books?id=ddGYYKnja1UC&lpg=PR21&dq=%22zero-day%20exploit%22&pg=PR21#v=onepage&q=%22zero-day%20exploit%22&f=false|page=xxi|publisher=Syngress|isbn=9780080543925
|passage=One of the more publicized cases that involved a zero-day '''exploit''' concerned the compromise of some U.S. military web servers. The attack involved exploiting a buffer overflow vulnerability in a core Windows component; {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2015|author=Joxean Koret; Elias Bachaalany|title=The Antivirus Hacker's Handbook|page=148
|passage=For example, you can create PE files that are valid PDF '''exploits''' or valid ZIP files, valid JPG files, and so on.}}
# {{lb|en|by extension|internet|video games}} An action or technique that [[take advantage|takes advantage]] of the [[condition]]s of a [[video game]] to gain an advantage, or to disadvantage others.

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[use]] (something) to someone's [[advantage]], such as one's own benefit or a [[society]]'s benefit.
#: {{syn|en|take advantage of|use|utilize}}
#: {{collocation|en|to '''exploit''' natural resources in a sustainable way}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Deepa Parent|title=Hundreds of gunshot eye injuries found in one Iranian hospital amid brutal crackdown on protests|date=2026-01-13|url=https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/jan/13/hundreds-of-gunshot-eye-injuries-found-in-one-iranian-hospital-amid-brutal-crackdown-on-protests|author2=William Christou|passage=The protests have alarmed authorities, and on Thursday night, they shut off internet and mobile access in the country, cutting the Iranian people off from the rest of the world. Rights groups have accused the government of '''exploiting''' the media blackout to carry out a brutal crackdown against protesters.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260124151459/https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/jan/13/hundreds-of-gunshot-eye-injuries-found-in-one-iranian-hospital-amid-brutal-crackdown-on-protests}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To make unfair use of someone else's labor, person, or property to one's own advantage.
#: {{cot|en|take advantage of|abuse|misuse}}
#: {{ux|en|Materialistic people who '''exploit''' others will come to a bad end.}}
